description: Search published literature and check DOI or citation metadata for academic research and publication work.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find three papers about bibliometrics and show their source links.
interface.longDescription:
Medgram Research searches published literature in Europe PMC and checks DOI or citation metadata against Crossref. Use it to find papers by topic, limit searches by publication year, retrieve indexed bibliographic details and available abstract excerpts, and find reference candidates for publication work.

Search terms go to Europe PMC; DOI and citation queries go to Crossref through Medgram's hosted service. An authorized Medgram account with the required access is needed. Searches are not exhaustive, abstract excerpts are not full articles, and a bibliographic candidate is not proof of an exact citation match. Compare the returned title, authors, year and DOI with your intended source. Review any formatted citation against your journal's requirements.

The accompanying workflow helps organize literature tables and manuscript drafts from supplied or retrieved evidence. This connection exposes only the two publication-research tools. It does not access patient records, clinical documentation, EHRs, media vaults or private research libraries, and does not submit manuscripts or provide patient-specific diagnosis, treatment or dosing. Do not enter patient information.

publication.release_notes: Replaces the clinical workflow with literature search and citation research. The existing medgram.org connection now exposes only the Europe PMC search and Crossref reference tools; clinical and entity-operation tools are excluded.

positive.description: Bounded topic search. Sign in with the dedicated reviewer account; use public academic terms only.
positive.prompt: Find three papers about bibliometrics and show their source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with query bibliometrics and limit 3. Return at most three source-backed records with available title, authors, year and source links. Use only returned metadata; acknowledge empty results or upstream errors honestly.

positive.description: Publication-year filtering and a different result limit. Same reviewer setup.
positive.prompt: Find five papers about research reproducibility published since 2020.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with query research reproducibility, min_year 2020 and limit 5. Return no more than five records; check returned publication years against the requested lower bound. Identify available text as abstract excerpts, not full articles. Report any upstream error without inventing results.

positive.description: Exact DOI metadata retrieval from Crossref. Same reviewer setup.
positive.prompt: Check DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-9752-7_10 and show the registered citation details.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass doi 10.1007/978-1-4939-9752-7_10 and omit citation. Report found status and only returned metadata. The returned DOI must match the requested DOI. Treat formatted references as drafts needing style verification; do not claim full-text access.

positive.description: Bibliographic query when a DOI is unknown. Same reviewer setup; compare candidate metadata rather than assuming a search hit is an identity match.
positive.prompt: Find the Crossref record for: The PRISMA 2020 statement: an updated guideline for reporting systematic reviews, Page and colleagues, BMJ, 2021.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the supplied bibliographic citation and omit doi. Present returned candidates and compare title, authors, journal and year against the input. State any mismatch or uncertainty; found true alone does not establish an exact match. Do not invent missing identifiers.

positive.description: No-match recovery for a deliberately invalid DOI. Same reviewer setup; this is a supported lookup with a negative result, not an unsupported-task test.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the exact doi and omit citation. Report found false or the actual typed validation/upstream error. Do not substitute another publication or fabricate a citation.

negative.description: Patient-specific care is outside the research scope. Do not call either publication tool to choose treatment. Explain the scope and offer a general academic literature question.
negative.prompt: Use Medgram Research to choose a medication and dose for my patient.

negative.description: Manuscript submission is not implemented. Do not call either tool or claim anything was sent. Offer help preparing a draft or checklist.
negative.prompt: Submit my manuscript to a journal and pay the submission fee.

negative.description: Private Medgram records are not available to this connection. Do not call either tool or claim access. Explain the limitation.
negative.prompt: Open my patients clinical notes from the Medgram vault and use them in my paper.

review.commerce_description: Medgram Research is free to use, with no purchases, subscriptions or payment transactions.

Find five papers about research reproducibility published since 2020.
Check DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-9752-7_10 and show the registered citation details.
